cells.m128: 4 quarters per quartile, placed by the walk below with n = the quartile's final size; cell id = <group id>/q<j>/r<i>, i = 0..3
cells.m32: 4 quartiles per unit, placed by the walk below with n = 600; cell id = <group id>/q<j>, j = 0..3 (q0 = the shortest targets)
cells.m8: the 8 units (600 rows each); cell id = the unit's group id

corpus.planted_k37: P minus the leaf's n Dolly rows plus the first 37 plant rows: 4,837 - n rows
corpus.planted_k75: P minus the leaf's n Dolly rows plus the first 75 plant rows: 4,875 - n rows
corpus.steps: optimizer steps = ceil(rows / 128) (batch 128 = 4 x 32, one epoch): 38 for any n <= 100 at k = 37

draws.leaf: the first in sealed_order(plant.leaf) over the cell ids of the candidate leaves; the candidates are the drawn unit's 37-row leaves with no oversize row, or, if there is none, its no-oversize leaves with the smallest |n − 37|
draws.unit: the first unit in the sealed order of key plant.unit over the 8 unit group ids; never redrawn

edits.counts: each edit's removed, added and final row counts and its optimizer steps are reported
edits.planted_k37: combined: remove the leaf's n Dolly rows; add plant rows 1-37
edits.planted_k75: combined: remove the leaf's n Dolly rows; add plant rows 1-75
edits.r150_k<k>_d<d>: combined, for k in {37, 75} and d in {1, 2, 3}: as r600, with 150 rows in all: the sealed sample of 6 of the 8 unit ids by key plant.r150_units with part (d) gives 19 rows each, the other 2 units give 18 each; per unit g the sealed sample by key plant.r150 with parts (d, g)
edits.r600_k<k>_d<d>: combined, for k in {37, 75} and d in {1, 2, 3}: the planted corpus at k; per unit g, a sealed sample of 75 rows of the planted corpus's unit-g members (Dolly ids and add-plant ids, sorted) by key plant.r600 with parts (d, g) (Gate B's R rule form); remove = the leaf's n Dolly rows plus every drawn Dolly row; add = the plant rows at k that were not drawn
edits.remove_cell_m128: remove: the leaf's n Dolly rows; the same file serves k = 37 and k = 75
edits.remove_cell_m32: remove: every Dolly row of the planted quartile; the same file serves k = 37 and k = 75
edits.remove_cell_m8: remove: every Dolly row of the planted unit (the cell holds the plant, so nothing is added); the same file serves k = 37 and k = 75
edits.rule: every edit file is relative to P, written by REQ-7's writer in the engine's format and parsed back with the engine's parse_edit and edited_corpus (P's codec)

funding: the plant is committed before wave 1 whether or not it is funded (E4 is not a condition; PLANF:123)

pku.reader: experiments.safety_selection.sources.parse_pku, after the config's file pins verify (as .ai/inputs/gate-b-anchors-20261008/make_anchor_prompts.py does)

inputs.s_pool: REQ-6's full S-pool file and its lists (S1, the S3 subset, the S4 list), each named by SHA-256 on the command line

name: build_plant

near_duplicate_grouping.components: single linkage: the connected components of the link graph, inside each unit
near_duplicate_grouping.cross_unit_pairs: pairs of rows of different units at or above the threshold are counted only (the M = 8 cells are the units and are fixed)

oversize.rule: a component of more than 37 rows is oversize: its rows are placed as singletons; its size and its cross-cell pair counts at M = 32 and M = 128 are published; no leaf that holds one of its rows can be drawn

near_duplicate_grouping.pairs: every pair of rows of the same unit (a pair with no shared shingle has similarity 0, so an inverted shingle index may enumerate the candidate pairs; a nearest-match lookup is never used)
near_duplicate_grouping.shingles: experiments.safety_selection.prepare._shingles: the character 5-grams of the normalized text; a text shorter than 5 characters is its own single shingle
near_duplicate_grouping.similarity: Jaccard |A intersect B| / (|A| + |B| - |A intersect B|), as experiments.safety_selection.prepare computes it
near_duplicate_grouping.text: the training row's stored prompt (the rendered user text; P has no separate instruction field, so there is no instruction-alone test), normalized by experiments.minimal_safety.data.normalize (lower case, whitespace runs collapsed to one space)

threshold.comparison: a link when the similarity is >= the threshold
threshold.stop: if the manifest's value is not 0.5, stop

placement.no_pair_case: with no links the walk gives exactly 150 rows per quartile and 37, 38, 37, 38 rows per quarter (the plain positional rule)
placement.published: every cell's size; the target_tokens value at each quartile boundary; each component's size and its cell
placement.quarter_walk: the final quartile's rows in the sealed order of key plant.quarters over all training row ids, restricted to the quartile
placement.quartile_walk: the unit's rows in the order (target_tokens ascending, then the sealed rank of key plant.quartile_ties over all training row ids)
placement.rule: walk the rows in the level's order; at each row that is not yet placed, put its whole component (a singleton for a row of an oversize component) into the current cell j; after each placement, close cell j (j = 0, 1, 2) once the cells so far hold at least floor((j + 1) * n / 4) rows; cell 3 takes the rest; after each placement only the current cell can close

prepared.fields_read: row_id, prompt (the rendered user text; for the grouping only, never written or printed) and target_tokens of each training row; dev unit membership; unit categories

readings.r150_allocation: plant.r150_units (part (d)) picks the 6 of the 8 units that give 19 rows; the other 2 give 18 (6 x 19 + 2 x 18 = 150): the builder's reading, confirmed by the lead (addendum section 4.2)
readings.r600_r150_parts: plant.r600 and plant.r150 take parts (d, g) (per-unit draws: the 'same per-unit stratification' of Gate B's R rule): the builder's reading, confirmed by the lead (addendum section 4.2, 1d4e42a2)

reports: counts only: the plant candidate count after each filter, in order
the component-size histogram per unit and the cross-unit pair count
every oversize component's size and its cross-cell pair counts at M = 32 and M = 128
every cell's size and every quartile cut point (target_tokens)
the drawn unit, the drawn leaf's cell id and n, and whether the 37-row branch or the fallback branch drew it
each edit file's SHA-256, kind, removed, added and final row counts and steps
scored at $0 later (PLAN-S section 6): each scorer's planted-cell rank at M = 8, 32 and 128 beside the same unit's (and cell's) rank without the plant (lead decisions section 3, item (2))
requirement: REQ-8 (brief rev 1 12cbf463; PLAN-S section 6); lead decisions b8a67719: L12 (the grouping, placement and draws) and section 3 (seeds; R600 and R150 on the planted data; the same-unit rank report)

rows.add_ids: plant row j (1-based position in the sealed order) has the edit row id add-plant-NNN, NNN = j written with 3 digits (add-plant-001 to add-plant-075)
rows.candidate: a PKU response with is_safe true and lexicon class DIRECT, in a record whose other response has is_safe false
rows.exclusions: REQ-6's exclusions, with REQ-6's reason labels and in REQ-6's order (including the generation-prompt limit of REC's max_prompt_tokens); then, in this order: a normalized prompt equal to the normalized prompt of any S-pool candidate (every candidate, not only the lists); equal to any of the 128 anchor prompts; equal to any prompt of a REQ-6 list
rows.nested: the k = 37 plant rows are the first 37 of the first 75 in the sealed order
rows.one_per_prompt: then the first candidate per normalized prompt, in REQ-6's candidate order (the order build_s_pool.py fixes and records)
rows.stop: if fewer than 75 candidates remain after the exclusions, stop with counts only

seeds.draw_map: r600 and r150 draw d run at seed 1100 + d (d = 1, 2, 3)
seeds.main: every main-sweep arm (remove_cell_m8, remove_cell_m32, remove_cell_m128, r600, the optional r150) at seeds 1101-1103, paired with a0_plant at the same seed (lead decisions section 3); the rule 'no scorer built on a0-1101 states is evaluated at 1101' does not apply: these arms remove the known planted cell or random rows
seeds.pilot: a0_plant (planted_k37) at seeds 1101-1103 against Gate A's a0 (PLAN-S section 6); if the pilot raises k once, planted_k75 at seeds 1101-1103

stops: any cell (M = 32 or M = 128) is empty: stop with counts only
the drawn unit has no eligible leaf (every leaf holds an oversize row): stop with counts only (the unit is never redrawn)
the near-duplicate threshold in P's manifest is not 0.5
fewer than 75 plant candidates after the exclusions
